Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
I do have some questions about the state and organization of V:EKN.
This is from http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=vekn
I assume the source is still correct.

>The V:EKN Administrative Board known as the Inner Circle consists of
>the following members:
>Robert Goudie, Chairman

What is the function of the chairman?

>LSJ, Rules Librarian

Rules Librarian = Rules Team?
This is for maintaining the V:EKN tournament rules I suppose?
Also for the list of errata and so on or is that property of White Wolf?

>Membership Director

Is this position vacant or is it Oscar?

>Robyn Tatu, Ratings Coordinator
>Peter Bakija, Clan Newsletter Editor

Pretty obvious, no questions :)

Also what kind of organization is V:EKN? It seems to be a free-form
thing to me, not related to White Wolf directly nor a really public
thing. Who is determining the structure of the V:EKN and who is
assigning board members?

--
Johannes Walch

Messages.Author: Shockwave
Messages.Body:
Fair question Johannes. In light of the recent WW open letter, I
wonder if they'll be interested in taking a more involved position?

Whether this is a good thing or not is down to your opinion of WW
control/involvement, and how much leeway will be accorded the non-WW
involvement, I suppose.

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
LSJ schrieb:


Thank you for the explanation. So as far as I can see there are you
(LSJ) taking care of all rules-related stuff and overseeing the overall
operations, Robyn entering and maintaining ratings and Peter who is
maintaining the Newsletters.

When I read "What is V:EKN" this paragraph stands out to me:

"Vampire: Elder Kindred NetworkTM is the Official V:TES Players'
Organization dedicated to the continued health of V:TES. The V:EKN
endeavors to help V:TES grow in popularity through the embracing of new
players as well as through the support of the existing fans."

I wonder what are the positions and people as well as mechanices to help
V:TES grow in popularity through the embracing of new players. I mean
maintaining rules and rating is basic stuff but it doesn´t exactly
embrace new players. Shouldn´t there be extra positions for that?

--
Johannes Walch

Messages.Author: preac...@gmx.at
Messages.Body:


In the past, the VEKN was an organisation run completely by volunteers
(i.e. the players themselves ran it).
It was founded back in the days when WotC stopped its commitment to
VTES.
As WW took over, the VEKN kinda made a slow transition to a company-
controlled entitity.

In the times when there was still a membership director, he actively
encouraged players to become princes.

Things change, and IMO, the VEKN serves a completely different role
than back in the old days.
